title: Re-Presentment Cushion for Ridgeline Consumer Credit Accounts With Returned Payments
content:
**Collections standard — re-presentment cushion.** A good-standing amount on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account carries a re-presentment cushion set by the account's payments returned unpaid in the last 24 months (dated less than 24 full months before today):

| Payments on the account returned unpaid in the last 24 months | Re-presentment cushion |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 25.00 |
| exactly 1 | 10.00 |
| none | nothing |

**How it is applied.** The good-standing amount is the unpaid minimum plus the late fees posted in the last month plus the interest bridge plus the re-presentment cushion, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Points of judgement

- Each returned payment counts once, by the date its return was posted on the account.
- A return posted exactly 24 full months before today falls outside the count; one posted a day later is inside.

**Hypothetical:** an unpaid minimum of 95.00, late fees of 32.00 and an interest bridge of 0.94 on an account with one returned payment in the last 24 months give 137.94; with two, 152.94.
